title: 算术右移 vs 除法：负数下的方向差异
expected_output:
=== arithmetic shift vs division in C ===
     x   x>>1    x/2    x<<1    x*2
     7      3       3      14      14
    -7     -4      -3     -14     -14
     8      4       4      16      16
    -8     -4      -4     -16     -16
     1      0       0       2       2
    -1     -1       0      -2      -2

notes:
  for negative odd x, x>>1 floors toward -inf but x/2 truncates toward 0
    -7 >> 1 = -4   while   -7 / 2 = -3
  signed right shift is IMPLEMENTATION-DEFINED (gcc: arithmetic); unsigned is always logical
  left-shifting a signed value that overflows is UNDEFINED BEHAVIOUR -> write 1u << n

=== logical shift on unsigned ===
  u = 80000000   u >> 1 = 40000000   (zeroes shift in from the left)
  (unsigned char)0x80 >> 1 = 40

=== rounding direction summary ===
  x >> 1 (signed, gcc) floors        -> use when you mean 'divide by 2, rounding down'
  x / 2 (C99)          truncates     -> use when you mean 'integer division'
